nodes.title: SG-8.4.4 context.md stack terms and stale text unit tests
nodes.body:
Context: SG-8.4 rewrites the repo-root context.md. Desired behavior: contextStack.test.ts passes. context.md names every STACK_TERMS entry and Go, has no stale README-only text and no UNKNOWN placeholder. Expected result: the five tests in game/frontend/tests/contextStack.test.ts pass. Why: the docs must match the real code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms runs with STACK_TERMS, then it returns []
- Given the repo-root context.md, when contextStackProblems runs, then it returns [], with no stale text, no UNKNOWN and Go present


## Scope
- In scope: STACK_TERMS and STALE_TEXT contract in docsCheck.ts
- In scope: contextStack.test.ts and docsCheck.test.ts
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code
- Out of scope: gameplay changes
- Preserve: Exports of docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts
- Preserve: existing tests


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 and the phaser-pin guard test keeps passing
- No test deleted or skipped
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No source file over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- contextStack and docsCheck tests pass
- typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: contextStackProblems reports every missing term, Go, stale string and UNKNOWN
nodes.body:
Context: docsCheck.ts exports STACK_TERMS, STALE_TEXT, staleTextHits and contextStackProblems. Desired behavior: they flag any missing term, missing Go, stale string and UNKNOWN. Expected result: a failing input yields the exact problem strings and a clean context.md yields [].

## Acceptance criteria
- Given text lacking Zustand, when contextStackProblems runs, then it contains 'missing term: Zustand'
- Given text with 'hello Worldseed' and UNKNOWN, when it runs, then it contains 'stale text: hello Worldseed' and 'UNKNOWN placeholder'


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts
- Out of scope: context.md content edits by Act
- Preserve: exported names and signatures


## Technical constraints
- No source file over 200 lines
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- docsCheck exports unchanged
- contract documented in the header


## Clarifying questions
- None
